statement: On both web stacks the adapter runs after Spring Boot's filters that rewrite the request (the hidden-method filter), and before everything that acts on it, so CoSec authorizes the request that is executed.
guards: spring-boot:RewritingFilterOrderTest#a hidden DELETE is authorized as the DELETE it is on Spring MVC
spring-boot:RewritingFilterOrderTest#a hidden DELETE is authorized as the DELETE it is on WebFlux
